title: Seats Held from the Waiting List: Billing from the Offer under the Student Transportation Services Fee Schedule
content:
A courtesy seat that Student Transportation Services holds for the family is billed from the offer. The seat was offered on the stop assignment date of the assignment.

| Offer compared with the signing of the courtesy rider permit agreement | Months added |
|---|---|
| offered in an earlier calendar month than the month the agreement is signed, and signed more than 10 calendar days after the stop assignment date | one month (1) |
| offered in an earlier calendar month, and signed 6 to 10 calendar days after the offer | half a month (0.5) |
| any other case | nothing |

Each month added is added to the billed share of the permit period at one month's share of the permit period, one divided by its months: 0.10 per month on a Courtesy Rider Permit (Annual) (10 months), 0.20 per month on a Courtesy Rider Permit (Semester) (5 months).

## Both sides (hypothetical offers)

| Seat offered | Agreement signed | Days after the offer | Months added |
|---|---|---|---|
| October 27 | November 7 | 11 | 1 |
| October 27 | November 6 | 10 | 0.5 |
| October 27 | November 2 | 6 | 0.5 |
| October 28 | November 2 | 5 | nothing |
| November 3 | November 20 | 17 | nothing (same calendar month) |
